mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as a continuous variable is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates compress discount rates and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 220 (current value 215.791) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 0.3pp and decline in PAYEMS below 10000 (current values: UNRATE=9.8, PAYEMS=130947.0) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 10000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 5%), a rise in CPIAUCSL above 220 signals overheating and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 and the regime condition (GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 5%) is met, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST above 600 (current value 598.0) signals robust housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 95 (current value 97.4422) signals a contraction in industrial production, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in RSAFS above 1% and HOUST above 1% signals robust consumer and housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both rise > 1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth rate in GDPC1 above 2% (current value 12901.5) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.
